title: Add config to disable automatic update warning
body:
I'm using NixOS. This means I have to create a custom derivation, and claude's updates are versioned through my config files. This is intended, and I do not want automatic updates.

Would this be considered as an option? Thank you!
author: TGlide

top_comments.author: wolffiex
top_comments.body:
Sorry, my fault. From the command line you can do
```
$ claude config set --global autoUpdaterStatus disabled
```

top_comments.author: wolffiex
top_comments.body: Thanks for this report! We are nix fans and want this tool to work well for you. At the same time, we'd love to be able to update our version frequently and bring our users along. If you have guidance on how this could work well with nix, please feel free to add details here.
